title: U Mass - Gamma-glutamyl Transferase Assay Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xwzfpf6
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove well contents and wash plate 2x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 25 µL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Wash Buffer into each well of the plate.

substeps.instruction: Seal and mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).
Decant Wash Buffer and remove residual amount by inverting the plate and tapping it smartly onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards, Controls, and Samples
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of the appropriate solution into the designated wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL of each Standard or Control solution into appropriate wells.
Add 25 µL of Assay Buffer for 0 pg/mL standard (Background) and to sample wells.
Add 25 µL of Sample (diluted one part serum or plasma to one part Assay Buffer) into appropriate wells.
Note: Use provided Serum Matrix for serum/plasma samples, or proper control culture medium for tissue culture/other supernatants.

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of the mixed or premixed beads to each well.

substeps.instruction: Shake bead bottle intermittently during addition to avoid settling.

steps.title: Incubate Beads Overnight
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a plate sealer and wrap with foil.

substeps.instruction: Incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18~20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Incubate at Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 1 hour at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 25 µL of Detection Antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Gently remove well contents and wash plate 2x following the Plate Washing procedure.

substeps.instruction: Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Wash plate with 200 µL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, and remove Wash Buffer by aspiration after each wash.
If using Bio-Tek ELx405 plate washer, follow instructed equipment settings.

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Sheath Fluid to all wells.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.
Set parameters for 125 µl and 75 beads per bead set.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Save and analyze the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data.

substeps.instruction: Use a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method for calculating cytokine/chemokines concentrations in samples.
For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.
